## 📚 Technical Research & Documentation
- [ ] **Research:** I have performed a technical watch / "veille" for this change.
- [ ] **ADR:** An Architectural Decision Record has been created/updated in `docs/adr/NNN-title.md`.
- [ ] **Justification:** I have included advantages, disadvantages, and learning curve analysis.

## 🧪 Proof of Functioning (PoC)
- [ ] **Functionality:** I have verified that the new technology/feature works as expected.
- [ ] **Compatibility:** I have checked compatibility with the existing project structure.
- [ ] **Tests:** (Optional) Automated tests pass or manual logs are attached.

## 🛠 Changes
- [ ] **Documentation:** `README.md` or other docs have been updated to reflect technical evolutions.
- [ ] **Architecture:** Any architectural changes are documented or visualized.
- [ ] **Code:** Implementation follows the project's coding standards.
